purpose: Directly address the judge's two remaining boundaries: replace the conjugate-posterior proxy with an actually trained and frozen neural posterior, and add a second paper-named simulation mechanism beyond Gaussian location.

prior_smoke_retained.scope: Functionality-only reduced smoke: 1,000 training rows, 20 OUP trajectories, 64 RFFs, four tests per level.
prior_smoke_retained.selection_rule: The smoke was used only to validate execution and memory. No full-run seed, threshold, or contamination level was selected from smoke outcomes.

neural_posterior.family: conditional diagonal Gaussian density network q_phi(theta|summary)
neural_posterior.test_time_rule: freeze every learned weight and every normalization statistic before the first contaminated test row
neural_posterior.baseline_and_mds_rule: query the identical frozen network with the ordinary versus MDS-adapted summary; no retraining, fine-tuning, or calibration on test theta

gaussian.evaluation_source: the prior reproduction's immutable 300 row official-RFF trial table

oup.source: pinned official tt_sbi/tasks/oup.py equations and config

frozen_gates.actual_neural_posteriors: both conditional density networks have more than 1,000 trained parameters and saved checkpoints
frozen_gates.frozen_gaussian_npe: exact tensor-state SHA-256 is unchanged before versus after all test-time adaptations
frozen_gates.frozen_oup_npe: exact tensor-state SHA-256 is unchanged before versus after all test-time adaptations
frozen_gates.gaussian_clean_calibration: baseline posterior-mean RMSE at epsilon 0 is below 0.20
frozen_gates.gaussian_all_contamination_levels_improv: MDS RMSE is lower at each epsilon in {0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4}
frozen_gates.gaussian_mean_robustness_gain_50pct: mean RMSE reduction over epsilon 0.1 through 0.4 is at least 50 percent
frozen_gates.oup_clean_npe_better_than_prior_scale: baseline posterior-mean RMSE at epsilon 0 is below 0.75
frozen_gates.oup_majority_contamination_levels_improv: MDS RMSE is lower at at least three of four nonzero epsilon levels
frozen_gates.oup_mean_contamination_gain_positive: mean OUP RMSE reduction over nonzero epsilon levels is positive
frozen_gates.paper_scale_rff_dimension: OUP adapter uses 512 random Fourier features

retention_and_no_posthoc_rule: All smoke and full outputs are retained. After the first full-run test response, no seed, architecture, mechanism, contamination level, threshold, or gate may change. A failed full gate remains a reported negative result.
